{{- /* Auto-generated folder pages (folders without index.md) → folder card page. Foundry also renders tag term pages through this template → creator/term-page.html. */ -}} {{ define "main" }} {{- $shell := "" -}} {{- $slug := partial "page-slug.html" . -}} {{- if or (eq .Kind "term") (strings.HasPrefix $slug "tags/") -}} {{- $shell = partial "creator/term-page.html" . -}} {{- else -}} {{- $n := partial "creator/page-node.html" . | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- if eq $n.g 0 -}} {{- $shell = partial "creator/folder-page.html" (dict "page" . "node" $n) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $shell = partial "creator/note-page.html" (dict "page" . "node" $n) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- partial "encrypt-content.html" (dict "Page" . "HTML" $shell) -}} {{ end }}
